_comment: The allowlist of packs the people build may read (openspec/changes/people-vat, design section 1). Each pack is pinned by the SHA-256 of its download; tools/deps/fetch_character_tools.py fetches them into ~/.cache/crab-breeze/deps (never the repository) and refuses a pack whose hash differs. tools/blender/build_people.py resolves every asset it reads against these packs only. The pins of the first two are Undercity's (fps-game-demo tools/deps/character_packs.json at 1363650). The GPL tool (MPFB) runs at build time only and never ships; its output and the CC0 assets are free to ship.
